description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure from the paper: it is the standard Crossref/publisher "Check for updates" logo artwork. It consists of a square graphic on a light grey gradient background with a thin darker vertical rule along the left edge and a faint rounded border near the top-left corner. The central motif is a circular ring drawn in two colours — a blue arc and a yellow arc — forming an open circular arrow, with the two open ends meeting at the top-left and lower-right of the ring. Inside the ring sits a solid red, flat bookmark/ribbon shape with a notched V-shaped bottom edge. Below the ring, the words "Check for updates" are set in dark grey/black sans-serif type on two lines, centred within the tile. There are no axes, no units, no scale bars, no legends, no data points, no panels and no sample labels anywhere in the image, and no caption was extracted for it. Consequently this figure group carries no materials-science content: it demonstrates nothing about the Fe40Mn19Ni15Al15Si10C1 high entropy steel, its MA/SPS processing, its phases (BCC cI2, τ-brass cI52, B2) or its mechanical properties. It appears to be an incidental icon captured in place of, or alongside, the actual figure artwork, and should not be treated as an evidence-bearing panel.
